pitLanes.modeReason: narrow lane squeezed between the start straight and the run to the Mountain; closed keeps it out of the racing
pitLanes.widthSource: estimated: Cadwell's pit lane is narrow (the start straight is 8.6-9.5 m); OSM maps it about 9 m from the track's centre

paddocks.name: Paddock (west of the run to the Mountain)
paddocks.source: hand-drawn over the LIDAR relief: the open ground reached by OSM's 'Paddock Entry' (142058939) and 'Paddock Exit' (117976649) service roads, beside the Club House and the scrutineering shed (117990859); OSM has no paddock polygon

gantries.name: start/finish line
gantries.source: the recipe's start/finish line (where the pit garage lane rejoins the pit lane; ukCircuits: the lights opposite the start of the pit exit lane)

gantries.name: footbridge at Woodland
gantries.source: LIDAR (EA NLP 2019, TF2580): a span across the whole road at s 2465-2467 m, top 7.9-8.3 m; not in OSM
gantries.note: an approved real span (Chris 2026-10-26): always the stock footbridge, scaled and nudged across the road so its pillars stand off the roads (preferably every part 4 m beyond the verge; nearer is reported, not swapped) (wfbuild/pits.py _span); restored 2026-10-26 (the start-straight footbridge before Coppice stays removed)

sources.osm: OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0: Overpass over the recipe bbox, 2026-10-24 (tools/real_tracks_data/fetch_pits_osm.py)
sources.lidar: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme point cloud 2019 (TF2580) minus the LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, OGL v3
sources.maps: MSV car circuit map (cadwellpark.co.uk): pit lane on the inside of the start straight, the paddock beyond the run to the Mountain
